```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library("GimmeMyOmics")
library("GimmmeMySC")
library("GimmeMyPlot")
library("Seurat")
library("scDblFinder")
library("BiocParallel")
library("parallel")

source(
  file.path(file.path(
  dirname(getwd()),
  "inst",
  "extdata"
), "conf.R"))

path_fig <- file.path(dirname(getwd()), "vignettes", "figures", "qc_doublets")
n_cores <- detectCores() - 1
```

```{r}
load(file.path(path_data, paste0(seurat_dataset, ".rda")))
Idents(seurat) <- snn_cluster
# seurat[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seurat[["RNA"]])
```

```{r}
if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
  bp_param <- SnowParam(workers = n_cores, type = "SOCK",  exportglobals = TRUE, progressbar = TRUE)
} else {
  bp_param <- MulticoreParam(workers = n_cores, progressbar = TRUE)
}

sce <- scDblFinder(
  GetAssayData(seurat[["RNA"]], slot = "counts"),
  samples = seurat$Patient,
  aggregateFeatures = FALSE,
  k = NULL,
  processing = "normFeatures",
  cluster = Idents(seurat),
  dims = 20,
  BPPARAM = bp_param
)
seurat$doublets <- sce[, row.names(seurat[[]])]$scDblFinder.class
seurat$doublet_score <- sce[, row.names(seurat[[]])]$scDblFinder.score
```

## QC Plot
```{r, fig.height = 8}
kable_doublet(seurat, split_by = snn_cluster, file = file.path(path_fig, "table_doublets_scDblFinder.png"))

plot_bar_doublet(seurat)
plot_bar_doublet(seurat, split_by = snn_cluster, pct = FALSE)
```

```{r}
plot_violin_doublet <- function(x) plot_sc_violin(x, features = "doublet_score", ncol = 1, nrow = 1)
plot_violin_doublet(seurat)
Idents(seurat) <- "doublets"
plot_violin_doublet(seurat)
```

```{r}
save(seurat, file = file.path(path_data, paste0(seurat_dataset, "2.rda")))
```
